items.desc: 伴隨閃電閃光重重砸下
items.style: 衝擊登場
items.prompt: 畫面先閃兩下強光並出現一道閃電線，文字從 2 倍大瞬間砸下縮回原尺寸，落地時輕微震動，之後保持柔和的外發光。整段約 2.4 秒，節奏急促有爆發力。
items.prompt_full:
「閃電砸落（Lightning Strike）」動態效果：畫面先閃兩下強光並出現一道閃電線，文字從 2 倍大瞬間砸下縮回原尺寸，落地時輕微震動，之後保持柔和的外發光。整段約 2.4 秒，節奏急促有爆發力。
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 1(s,x){s.append(el('div','flash'));s.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<svg viewBox="0 0 160 90" preserveAspectRatio="none"><polyline points="95,0 82,30 92,32 74,60 84,62 70,90" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>');s.append(T(x))}

items.desc_en: Slams down hard with a lightning flash
items.prompt_en: The screen first flashes brightly twice and a lightning bolt appears; the text slams down instantly from 2x size and shrinks back to its original size, trembling slightly on landing, then keeps a soft outer glow. The whole sequence lasts about 2.4 seconds, with a fast, explosive rhythm.
items.style_en: Impact Entrance
items.prompt_full_en:
"Lightning Strike (閃電砸落)" motion effect: The screen first flashes brightly twice and a lightning bolt appears; the text slams down instantly from 2x size and shrinks back to its original size, trembling slightly on landing, then keeps a soft outer glow. The whole sequence lasts about 2.4 seconds, with a fast, explosive rhythm.
Colors: please match the website's existing theme colors and style yourself; do not specify any additional colors.

items.desc: 雷射把文字一刀兩斷
items.style: 消散退場
items.prompt: 一道帶光暈的雷射線由左往右快速橫切文字中線，切過後文字上半部往左上、下半部往右下錯開並微微傾斜，停留片刻再合回。約 2.6 秒一輪，俐落科幻感。
items.prompt_full:
「雷射切斷（Laser Cut）」動態效果：一道帶光暈的雷射線由左往右快速橫切文字中線，切過後文字上半部往左上、下半部往右下錯開並微微傾斜，停留片刻再合回。約 2.6 秒一輪，俐落科幻感。
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 2(s,x){const w=el('div','w');const a=T(x);a.classList.add('top');const b=T(x);b.classList.add('bot');w.append(a,b,el('div','laser'));s.append(w)}

items.desc_en: A laser slices the text in two
items.prompt_en: A glowing laser line cuts rapidly from left to right across the middle of the text; after it passes, the top half of the text shifts up-left and the bottom half shifts down-right, tilting slightly, pauses for a moment, then comes back together. About 2.6 seconds per cycle, with a crisp sci-fi feel.
items.style_en: Dissipating Exit
items.prompt_full_en:
"Laser Cut (雷射切斷)" motion effect: A glowing laser line cuts rapidly from left to right across the middle of the text; after it passes, the top half of the text shifts up-left and the bottom half shifts down-right, tilting slightly, pauses for a moment, then comes back together. About 2.6 seconds per cycle, with a crisp sci-fi feel.

example.javascript_fx: 4(s,x){const t=split(x);t.querySelectorAll('.c').forEach(c=>{c.style.setProperty('--dx',rnd(-40,40)+'cqw');c.style.setProperty('--dy',rnd(-30,30)+'cqw');c.style.setProperty('--r',rnd(-200,200)+'deg')});s.append(t)}

About 2.8 seconds per cycle, with a strong sense of impact.

items.desc: 文字化為粒子消散
items.style: 消散退場
items.prompt: 文字由左到右逐字變模糊、往右上飄散並淡出，同時周圍冒出許多小方塊粒子往外飄走，消失後再重新浮現。約 3 秒一輪，戲劇化。
items.prompt_full:
「粒子消散（Disintegrate）」動態效果：文字由左到右逐字變模糊、往右上飄散並淡出，同時周圍冒出許多小方塊粒子往外飄走，消失後再重新浮現。約 3 秒一輪，戲劇化。
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 5(s,x){const w=el('div');w.style.position='relative';const t=split(x,18);w.append(t);for(let i=0;i<46;i++){const p=el('i','p');p.style.left=rnd(5,95)+'%';p.style.top=rnd(10,90)+'%';p.style.setProperty('--dx',rnd(5,40)+'cqw');p.style.setProperty('--dy',rnd(-25,5)+'cqw');p.style.animationDelay=(parseFloat(p.style.left)/100*.5)+'s';w.append(p)}s.append(w)}

items.desc: 文字萬花筒旋轉
items.style: 3D 空間旋轉
items.prompt: 同一個詞複製 12 份，以中心點放射狀排列成花朵形，整體持續慢速旋轉，每份文字同時往外伸縮呼吸，形成萬花筒效果，相鄰的複本用深淺兩種色調交錯。旋轉一圈約 7 秒。
items.prompt_full:
「文字萬花筒（Text Kaleido）」動態效果：同一個詞複製 12 份，以中心點放射狀排列成花朵形，整體持續慢速旋轉，每份文字同時往外伸縮呼吸，形成萬花筒效果，相鄰的複本用深淺兩種色調交錯。旋轉一圈約 7 秒。
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 7(s,x){const k=el('div','k');for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const sp=el('span');sp.innerHTML=`${x}`;sp.style.transform=`rotate(${i*30}deg) translateY(-50%)`;k.append(sp)}s.append(k)}

items.desc_en: Text rotates in a kaleidoscope

One full rotation takes about 7 seconds.

One full rotation takes about 7 seconds.

items.desc: 倒數數字重重砸下

items.prompt_full:
「倒數砸落（Number Slam）」動態效果：倒數「3、2、1、GO!」依序出現，每個數字從 3 倍大猛力砸下、回彈到原尺寸，每個數字約 0.75 秒，GO! 用強調色凸顯。粗黑體，開場感強烈。
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 8(s,x,card){const seq=['3','2','1','GO!'];let i=0;const show=()=>{s.querySelector('.n')?.remove();const n=el('div','n'+(seq[i]==='GO!'?' go':''),seq[i]);s.append(n);i=(i+1)%seq.length};show();card._timers.push(setInterval(show,750))}

items.desc: 文字如雨般落下

example.preview_text: あいうえおかきくけこさしすせそたちつてとなにぬねのはひふへほまみむめもやゆよらりるれろ
example.javascript_fx: 11(s,x){s.classList.add('fx11');const pool=chars(x);for(let i=0;i<13;i++){const c=el('div','col'+(Math.random()<.25?' a':''));let str='';for(let j=0;j<12;j++)str+=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];c.textContent=str;c.style.left=(i*7.8+1)+'%';const d=rnd(2.8,5.5);c.style.animationDuration=d+'s';c.style.animationDelay=-rnd(0,d)+'s';s.append(c)}}

「放大鏡（Magnifier Lens）」動態效果：一個圓形放大鏡在文字上左右來回移動，鏡片範圍內的文字放大約 1.5 倍並改用強調色，鏡片外的文字較淡，放大鏡附手把。來回約 6 秒，解說／發現感。

example.javascript_fx:
12(s,x,card){const w=el('div','w');const b=T(x);b.classList.add('base');const o=T(x);o.classList.add('ov');const l=el('div','lens');w.append(b,o,l);s.append(w);
  ticks.set(card,t=>{const W=w.offsetWidth,H=w.offsetHeight;if(!W)return;const px=W*(.5+.42*Math.sin(t*1.1));const r=H*.62;o.style.transformOrigin=`${px}px 50%`;o.style.transform='scale(1.55)';o.style.clipPath=`circle(${r}px at ${px}px 50%)`;l.style.left=px+'px';l.style.width=l.style.height=(r*2*1.55)+'px'})}

25(s,x,card){const w=el('div','w');const t=split(x);const ball=el('div','ball');w.append(t,ball);s.append(w);const cs=[...t.querySelectorAll('.c')];const per=.38,n=cs.length,cyc=n*per+1.2;
  ticks.set(card,tt=>{const ph=tt%cyc;const k=ph/per;const idx=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(k));const fr=Math.min(1,k-idx);const c=cs[idx];if(!c)return;const cx=c.offsetLeft+c.offsetWidth/2;ball.style.left=cx+'px';ball.style.transform=`translateY(${-Math.sin(Math.PI*fr)*w.offsetHeight*.35}px)`;cs.forEach((e,i)=>e.classList.toggle('on',ph<n*per+1?i<=idx&&(i<idx||fr>.5):false))})}

example.javascript_fx:
68(s,x,card){const cv=el('canvas');s.append(cv);const R=16;const off=document.createElement('canvas');const oc=off.getContext('2d');oc.font=`900 ${R-2}px "Noto Sans JP",sans-serif`;const tw=Math.ceil(oc.measureText(x).width)+R;off.width=tw;off.height=R;oc.font=`900 ${R-2}px "Noto Sans JP",sans-serif`;oc.fillStyle='#fff';oc.textBaseline='middle';oc.fillText(x,0,R/2+1);const px=oc.getImageData(0,0,tw,R).data;const on=(cx,cy)=>px[(cy*tw+((cx%tw)+tw)%tw)*4+3]>110;const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
  ticks.set(card,t=>{const W=s.offsetWidth,H=s.offsetHeight;if(!W)return;const dpr=devicePixelRatio||1;if(cv.width!==W*dpr){cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr}const cell=cv.height/(R+6);const cols=Math.ceil(cv.width/cell);const sh=Math.floor(t*14);ctx.fillStyle='#161616';ctx.fillRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);for(let cy=0;cy<R;cy++)for(let cx=0;cx<cols;cx++){const o=on(cx+sh,cy);ctx.fillStyle=o?getComputedStyle(s).getPropertyValue('--a')||'#d9f53a':'#2a2a2a';if(o)ctx.fillStyle='#d9f53a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx*cell+cell/2,(cy+3)*cell+cell/2,cell*.38,0,7);ctx.fill()}})}

example.javascript_fx:
95(s,x){const l=layer(s);const b=el('button','mbtn');const sp=el('span');sp.textContent=x;b.append(sp);l.append(b);const q=(e,k)=>gsap.quickTo(e,k,{duration:.7,ease:'elastic.out(1,.4)'});const bx=q(b,'x'),by=q(b,'y'),tx=q(sp,'x'),ty=q(sp,'y');
  pointer(l,(px,py)=>{const W=l.offsetWidth,H=l.offsetHeight,dx=px-W/2,dy=py-H/2,on=Math.hypot(dx,dy)<W*.26;bx(on?dx*.4:0);by(on?dy*.4:0);tx(on?dx*.2:0);ty(on?dy*.2:0);b.classList.toggle('on',on)},[[.15,.25],[.42,.45],[.56,.56],[.5,.5],[.85,.3],[.62,.62],[.2,.8]])}

items.desc_en: Side navigation dots light up with scrolling; click one to jump to that section
items.prompt_en: Scroll navigation / side navigation dots (Scroll Spy / Dot Navigation, also called anchor navigation or page progress navigation): a row of small dots is fixed on the right side of the page, each dot corresponding to one section; whichever section is scrolled to, its corresponding dot enlarges and fills with the accent color, with a pill label showing that section's name floating out beside it; between the dots there is a thin track, and the progress bar inside the track grows downward in proportion to the whole page's scrolling; clicking any dot smoothly scrolls to that section, and hovering the mouse over a dot also shows its name. The sections alternate between light and dark background shades. (GSAP: one ScrollTrigger per section, start "top center", end "bottom center", onToggle toggles active; the progress bar uses scaleY with scrub:true; clicking uses gsap.to(scroller,{scrollTop}) or ScrollToPlugin)

items.desc: hover 時字逐一往上翻滾、按鈕反轉、箭頭轉向

items.prompt: 膠囊形按鈕，左邊文字、右邊一顆圓形箭頭。滑鼠移上去時，按鈕文字的每個字依序往上翻滾（每字延遲約 0.035 秒），下方一模一樣的文字從底下補上來；同時按鈕底色與文字色互換成強調配色，右側圓圈也跟著反轉配色，並把箭頭轉成往右上 45 度；滑鼠離開時全部反向翻回。整體約 0.55 秒、緩入緩出（cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)）。（CSS：每個字包 span，用 ::after{content:attr(data-t);top:100%} 做第二份文字，外層 overflow:hidden，:hover 時 translateY(-100%)，transition-delay 用 calc(var(--i)*.035s) 做逐字錯開）

items.desc_en: On hover the letters roll up one by one, the button inverts, and the arrow turns
items.prompt_en: A pill-shaped button, with text on the left and a circular arrow on the right. When the mouse moves over it, each letter of the button text rolls upward in sequence (each letter delayed by about 0.035 seconds), with an identical copy of the text filling in from below; at the same time, the button's background and text colors swap to the accent scheme, the circle on the right also inverts its colors, and the arrow rotates to point up-right at 45 degrees; when the mouse leaves, everything rolls back in reverse. The whole thing takes about 0.55 seconds, with ease-in-out (cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)). (CSS: each letter wrapped in a span, ::after{content:attr(data-t);top:100%} creates the second copy of the text, the outer layer has overflow:hidden, on :hover translateY(-100%), and transition-delay uses calc(var(--i)*.035s) to stagger the letters)

items.desc: 從滑鼠進入的位置擴散填滿，離開時往出口收回
items.style: 按鈕 hover 方向感知 擴散 填色 漣漪 從滑鼠位置 Direction Aware Hover Fill Ripple Button CTA
items.prompt: 描邊膠囊按鈕。滑鼠移入時，一個強調色圓形從「游標進入按鈕的那一點」開始放大，擴散到填滿整顆按鈕，文字顏色同時切換成與填色有反差的顏色；滑鼠移出時，圓形改以「游標離開的那一點」為中心縮小消失，所以從哪邊出去、顏色就往哪邊收。約 0.55 秒、緩入緩出。（做法：按鈕 overflow:hidden；pointerenter / pointerleave 時用 getBoundingClientRect 算出游標在按鈕內的座標，寫進 CSS 變數 --x、--y，圓的直徑取「到最遠角距離 × 2」確保蓋滿；圓用 transform:scale(0→1) 做 transition）

items.desc_en: Spreads to fill from the point where the mouse entered, and retracts toward the exit point on leave
items.prompt_en: An outlined pill button. When the mouse moves in, an accent-colored circle enlarges starting from "the exact point where the cursor entered the button", spreading until it fills the whole button, while the text color switches at the same time to a color that contrasts with the fill; when the mouse moves out, the circle shrinks away centered on "the point where the cursor left", so the color retracts toward whichever side it exits from. About 0.55 seconds, ease-in-out. (How it works: the button has overflow:hidden; on pointerenter / pointerleave, getBoundingClientRect is used to calculate the cursor's coordinates inside the button and write them into the CSS variables --x and --y, the circle's diameter is taken as "distance to the farthest corner × 2" to ensure full coverage; the circle uses transform:scale(0→1) as a transition)

items.desc_en: On hover the image tilts in 3D following the cursor, with layered parallax scenery, a glare, and a caption sliding out
items.prompt_en: An image card: when the mouse moves over the image, the whole image tilts in 3D in the direction of the cursor position (up to about ±10 degrees) and scales up slightly; the far, middle and near scenery inside the image shift in the opposite direction at different rates, forming parallax depth; a soft glare follows the cursor; at the same time, the caption text at the bottom (a small label + a title) slides up from below. items.style: 背景 網格 格線 聚光 游標 光暈 Spotlight Grid Pattern Cursor Glow SaaS

items.desc: 漂浮的粒子靠近時自動連線，游標會吸引附近粒子
items.style: 背景 粒子 連線 網路 星座 Particles Network Constellation particles.js Canvas
items.prompt: 背景有數十顆小粒子緩慢隨機漂浮、碰到邊界反彈；兩顆粒子距離夠近時自動連一條線，越近線越清楚、越遠越淡；游標移入時，附近粒子會被輕輕吸過去並和游標連線，形成像星座網路的效果。前景標題保持清楚。（Canvas 2D：requestAnimationFrame 每幀更新位置，兩兩計算距離畫線並依距離調整透明度；注意依 devicePixelRatio 設定畫布尺寸）

items.desc_en: Floating particles automatically connect when close; the cursor attracts nearby particles
items.prompt_en: Dozens of small particles in the background drift slowly and randomly, bouncing off the boundaries; when two particles are close enough they automatically connect with a line — the closer they are, the clearer the line, the farther, the fainter; when the cursor moves in, nearby particles are gently drawn toward it and connect to it, forming an effect like a constellation network. The foreground title stays clear. (Canvas 2D: requestAnimationFrame updates the positions every frame, lines are drawn by computing pairwise distances with opacity adjusted by distance; note the canvas size should be set according to devicePixelRatio)

items.desc_en: A line trails behind the cursor, growing thinner and fainter

items.prompt_full_en:
"Cursor Trail (游標拖尾軌跡)" motion effect: When the cursor moves, a smooth line trails behind it — thicker and clearer the closer it is to the cursor, thinner and more transparent toward the tail, like a comet's tail; when the cursor stops, the tail gradually retracts to the cursor's position; the cursor itself is a small dot. (Canvas 2D: each frame, push the cursor coordinates into an array and keep only the most recent ~28 points, draw line segments in sequence, with line width and opacity increasing with the index; set the canvas size according to devicePixelRatio; the container uses cursor:none)

items.prompt_full:

items.desc_en: Clicking anywhere on screen spreads a ripple from the click point
items.prompt_en: When clicking anywhere inside the section, a translucent solid circle and an outline ring spread out from the click point at the same time (the outline ring slightly later, by 0.12 seconds), both scaling from 0 up to several times the size of a thumb and fading out, in about 0.85 seconds with strong deceleration, giving the user clear click feedback; rapid repeated clicks are possible, and the ripples overlap. (How it works: on pointerdown, create circular elements at the click coordinates, CSS keyframes do scale(0→1) + opacity(1→0), and the elements are removed when the animation ends)

items.desc_en: A ring of text keeps rotating around the cursor
items.prompt_en: Hide the system cursor and replace it with a small dot, surrounded by a ring of text arranged along a circle (for example "SCROLL · EXPLORE ·" repeated); the text ring keeps rotating slowly (about 8 seconds per revolution), and the whole assembly follows the cursor with a slight lag; the large background heading stays very faint, making the cursor the focus. (How it works: an SVG circular path + textPath, using textLength so the text exactly fills one revolution; the outer layer's transform follows the cursor, and the inner svg uses a CSS rotation animation)

"Z-pattern Reveal (Z 字閱讀動線)" motion effect: When a homepage hero enters, the elements fade in and rise in sequence following a Z-pattern reading path: logo at top left → navigation menu at top right → main heading and body copy on the left → hero image on the right → call-to-action button at bottom left → secondary link at bottom right. Each element is spaced about 0.4 seconds apart, rising gently from about 12px below, with an even rhythm and no exaggerated displacement, so the user's gaze moves in the designed order. (The thin lines in the preview only illustrate the Z path and are not needed on a real site. GSAP: arrange the elements in an array in reading order, fromTo y:12 / opacity:0, stagger 0.42, ease power2.out)

items.desc_en: Upload your own line SVG and watch it drawn stroke by stroke, as if by a pen
items.prompt_en: Turn the line SVG I provide (pasted after these instructions) into a 'drawn with a pen' entrance: each path is traced one after another in its original drawing order, with each stroke's drawing time allocated by length (longer lines draw longer, shorter ones quicker), the strokes slightly overlapping as they connect, about 3 seconds overall, ease-in-out; after finishing, it can hold then fade out and replay, or play only once. (GSAP: DrawSVGPlugin; for each path / line / polyline / circle, fromTo drawSVG "0%"→"100%" in sequence, with duration calculated in proportion to getTotalLength(); pure CSS can also do this with stroke-dasharray + stroke-dashoffset)

items.desc_en: A pen tip writes along a signature path, finishing with an underline
items.prompt_en: A cursive signature line path is slowly written out starting from where the pen first touches, with a small round pen tip following at the very front of the path, as if someone is really writing (about 2.6 seconds, ease-in-out); once the signature is finished, the pen tip disappears and a slightly curved underline is quickly drawn underneath to finish. Suited to a portfolio hero or brand signature. (GSAP: DrawSVGPlugin draws the signature path while MotionPathPlugin moves the pen-tip dot along the same path, with identical timing and ease for both; the signature must be a single-stroke outline path, not outlined letterforms)

items.desc_en: Pull a list down, a spinning icon appears, and on release it loads and springs back
items.prompt_en: When you pull down at the top of a mobile list page, the list follows the finger downward (the further you pull, the greater the resistance), and a circular loading icon is revealed above; the icon's rotation angle increases with the pull distance. On release, the icon keeps spinning to indicate loading; when loading finishes, the list smoothly springs back to the top, and the newest item is briefly highlighted before fading back. (GSAP: get the pull distance from the gesture using Draggable or Observer and multiply it by a damping coefficient; on release, a timeline: spinner rotation → list y back to 0 (power3.out) → the new item's background fades out)

items.prompt_full_en:

items.desc_en: As the cursor sweeps over a row of icons, nearby icons magnify and push their neighbors aside
items.prompt_en: A row of rounded icons like the macOS Dock: when the cursor moves left and right near the icon row, the icon closest to the cursor magnifies to about 1.9x, and the neighboring icons to its left and right magnify in decreasing amounts according to distance, forming a smooth magnification peak and pushing the other icons aside to both sides; when the cursor leaves, all return to their original size. items.desc_en: Hundreds of fine lines flow slowly along an invisible current; the cursor stirs the flow
items.prompt_en: The background is filled with hundreds of invisible small particles. Each particle advances according to the 'flow direction' at its location (determined by smoothly varying noise or trigonometric functions, and changing slowly over time) and leaves a very fine trail. items.desc_en: A gradient flows continuously along a line, and a point of light travels around the line
items.prompt_en: A closed, infinity-symbol-shaped curve. The line itself is a multicolored gradient, and the gradient flows continuously along the direction of the line; at the same time a small, bright point of light travels around the line like a comet, with a slight glow. items.desc_en: When switching pages, three curtains fall in sequence to cover the screen, then retract downward to reveal the new page
items.prompt_en: When a navigation click switches the page, three vertical strip curtains fall from the top in sequence (about 0.08 seconds apart) to cover the whole screen — at this moment the page behind is replaced with the new page — then the three curtains retract downward in sequence, and the new page's title and content blocks fade in and float up from top to bottom. The whole sequence takes about 1.4 seconds, giving page changes a complete sense of rhythm. (GSAP: curtains yPercent -101 to 0 to 101, stagger 0.08, ease power3.inOut; switch the content in the callback between the two segments; for an SPA it can be paired with Barba.js or a framework's route transition hooks)

items.desc: 一整片細線像布料般起伏，游標經過的地方被輕輕拱起
items.style: 線條 波浪 起伏 布料 地形 等高線 Wavy Lines Wave Field Terrain Canvas 互動背景 requestAnimationFrame 背景 氛圍
items.prompt: 整個背景是約 26 條水平細線，每條線由兩組不同頻率的正弦波疊加而起伏，並隨時間緩慢流動，相鄰的線相位略錯開，整片看起來像飄動的布料或地形線；其中每隔幾條用較粗、較亮的線點綴；游標經過的地方，附近的線條會被平滑地往上拱起，離開後恢復。（Canvas 2D：每條線取 80 個點，y = 基準 + sin(x×f1 + t + j×相位) × A1 + sin(x×f2 − t + j×相位) × A2，再減去以游標為中心的高斯函數 × 高度）
items.prompt_full:
「起伏線條（Wavy Lines）」動態效果：整個背景是約 26 條水平細線，每條線由兩組不同頻率的正弦波疊加而起伏，並隨時間緩慢流動，相鄰的線相位略錯開，整片看起來像飄動的布料或地形線；其中每隔幾條用較粗、較亮的線點綴；游標經過的地方，附近的線條會被平滑地往上拱起，離開後恢復。（Canvas 2D：每條線取 80 個點，y = 基準 + sin(x×f1 + t + j×相位) × A1 + sin(x×f2 − t + j×相位) × A2，再減去以游標為中心的高斯函數 × 高度）

items.desc_en: A whole field of fine lines undulates like fabric, and the places the cursor passes are gently arched up

example.javascript_fx:
231(s,x){const w=el('div','abs bga-fs');const K=['c','q','t','ring','c','q','t','ring','c','plus','q','plus'];const es=K.map((k,i)=>{const e=el('i','bga-'+k);e.style.cssText=`left:${rnd(4,90)}%;top:${rnd(6,82)}%;--z:${rnd(3,7)}cqw;color:${i%3?'var(--a)':GC[i%5]}`;w.append(e);return e});s.append(w,T(x,Math.min(12,56/chars(x).length)));
  es.forEach(e=>{gsap.to(e,{x:'random(-40,40)',y:'random(-30,30)',rotation:'random(-120,120)',duration:'random(3,6)',ease:'sine.inOut',repeat:-1,yoyo:true,repeatRefresh:true});gsap.from(e,{scale:0,opacity:0,duration:.8,ease:'back.out(2)',delay:rnd(0,.8)})})}

items.desc: 從手指點下的位置擴散出一圈漣漪，Material Design 經典回饋
items.style: 漣漪 水波 點擊 回饋 Material Design Ripple Click Feedback Ink 按鈕
items.prompt: 點擊按鈕時，從手指（游標）按下的那個點擴散出一個圓形漣漪，漣漪半透明、由小放大到能蓋住整顆按鈕的大小並同時淡出，約 0.7 秒；連續點擊可同時出現多個漣漪。（JS：pointerdown 時計算點擊位置與到最遠角落的距離 × 2 當直徑，插入一個圓形 span，CSS keyframes scale 0→1、opacity 漸消，animationend 時移除；按鈕 overflow:hidden）
items.prompt_full:
「按鈕漣漪回饋（Ripple Click）」動態效果：點擊按鈕時，從手指（游標）按下的那個點擴散出一個圓形漣漪，漣漪半透明、由小放大到能蓋住整顆按鈕的大小並同時淡出，約 0.7 秒；連續點擊可同時出現多個漣漪。（JS：pointerdown 時計算點擊位置與到最遠角落的距離 × 2 當直徑，插入一個圓形 span，CSS keyframes scale 0→1、opacity 漸消，animationend 時移除；按鈕 overflow:hidden）
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx:
234(s,x,card){const b=bxBtn('bx-rp',x);s.append(b);const rip=(px,py)=>{const r=el('i');const W=b.offsetWidth,H=b.offsetHeight,d=Math.hypot(Math.max(px,W-px),Math.max(py,H-py))*2;r.style.cssText=`left:${px}px;top:${py}px;width:${d}px;height:${d}px`;b.append(r);r.addEventListener('animationend',()=>r.remove())};
  b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();rip(e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top)});bxDemo(b,card,()=>rip(rnd(.15,.85)*b.offsetWidth,rnd(.2,.8)*b.offsetHeight),1100)}

items.desc_en: A ripple spreads out from the exact position the finger taps, the classic Material Design feedback

(JS: on pointerdown, calculate the click position and the distance to the farthest corner x 2 as the diameter, insert a circular span, CSS keyframes scale 0 to 1 with opacity fading, and remove it on animationend; the button has overflow:hidden)

items.desc_en: While typing a password, the strength bar below grows segment by segment, changing with strength and showing a hint
items.prompt_en: Below a password input field are four strength segments: as the user types, the strength is calculated in real time (whether the length reaches 8 characters, and whether it has uppercase letters, numbers and symbols); the more conditions met, the more segments grow out from left to right; the higher the strength, the stronger the segments' visual, and the text below shows in sequence "Too Weak / Fair / Good / Very Strong"; on the right of the input is an eye button to show/hide the password; when the input is focused its border lights up. (JS: the input event calculates a score of 0-4, sets data-level and each segment's class; newly lit segments grow with a scaleX 0 to 1 keyframes)

items.style: 滑桿 拉桿 數值 氣泡 範圍 音量 Range Slider Tooltip Bubble Value Input 表單 控制項

items.desc_en: While dragging the slider, a value bubble pops up above, moves with the handle, and shrinks back on release
items.prompt_en: A range slider: the portion of the track already dragged over is filled; when the handle is held or dragged, it enlarges slightly, and a value bubble with a small triangle pops up directly above it; the bubble moves horizontally with the handle and displays the number in real time; on release the bubble shrinks and fades out. (CSS: customize the track of input[type=range] and its ::-webkit-slider-thumb; the track fill uses a background linear-gradient with a CSS variable percentage; the bubble is an absolutely positioned output, with left = handle width / 2 + (track width - handle width) x percentage, popping with scale and opacity)

items.desc: 四格驗證碼，輸入一格自動跳下一格；正確時依序跳起，錯誤時整排抖動
items.style: 驗證碼 OTP 一次性密碼 簡訊 登入 PIN Code Input Verification Auto Focus 表單 控制項
items.prompt: 四格驗證碼輸入框：每格只能輸入一個數字，輸入後該格輕彈一下並自動跳到下一格，在空格按倒退鍵會回到上一格並清除；四格填滿後自動驗證：正確時每格依序向上跳起並填滿底色，錯誤時整排左右抖動、外框變成警示樣式。（JS：每格 maxLength=1、inputMode="numeric"，input 事件後 focus 下一格，keydown Backspace 處理倒退；結果用 class 觸發 CSS keyframes，跳起用 animation-delay 錯開；手機上字級至少 16px 避免自動放大）

items.desc_en: A four-box verification code; typing one box auto-advances to the next; the boxes jump up in sequence when correct, and the whole row shakes when wrong
items.prompt_en: A four-box verification code input: each box can hold only one digit; after typing, that box gives a light bounce and focus automatically advances to the next box; pressing Backspace in an empty box returns to the previous box and clears it; once all four boxes are filled it automatically verifies: when correct, each box jumps up in sequence and its background fills; when wrong, the whole row shakes left and right and the border changes to a warning style. (JS: each box has maxLength=1 and inputMode="numeric"; the input event focuses the next box, keydown Backspace handles going back; the result triggers CSS keyframes with a class, staggering the jumps with animation-delay; on mobile the font size is at least 16px to avoid auto-zoom)

items.desc: 圓形游標依移動速度沿著方向拉長，停下來時恢復圓形
items.style: 速度 拉伸 拉長 彈性 方向 Velocity Stretch Squash Cursor Elastic 游標 滑鼠
items.prompt: 一顆圓形游標以平滑延遲跟隨滑鼠，每幀計算移動速度：移動越快，圓形越沿著移動方向被拉長、垂直方向變扁，像有彈性的果凍；滑鼠停下時慢慢恢復成正圓。（JS requestAnimationFrame：位置 lerp 追上目標；速度 = 這幀位移長度，角度 = atan2(dy,dx)；transform = translate → rotate(角度) → scale(1 + 速度係數, 1 − 速度係數 × 0.45)，速度係數本身也 lerp 避免抖動）
items.prompt_full:

items.desc_en: A circular cursor stretches along its direction according to movement speed, and returns to a circle when it stops
items.prompt_en: A circular cursor follows the mouse with a smooth delay, calculating movement speed every frame: the faster it moves, the more the circle is stretched along the movement direction and flattened vertically, like elastic jelly; when the mouse stops, it slowly recovers into a perfect circle. (JS requestAnimationFrame: position lerps toward the target; speed = the length of this frame's displacement, angle = atan2(dy,dx); transform = translate → rotate(angle) → scale(1 + speed coefficient, 1 − speed coefficient × 0.45), and the speed coefficient itself is also lerped to avoid jitter)

items.desc_en: A pair of large eyes whose pupils keep staring and turning toward the cursor, blinking occasionally
items.prompt_en: A pair of large eyes (eye whites + pupils, with a small highlight dot on each pupil), whose pupils keep turning toward the cursor direction: the farther the cursor, the closer the pupils get to the edge of the eye socket, and when the cursor is directly in front of the eyes the pupils return to the center; every few seconds both eyes blink quickly together once (the eyes flatten vertically and recover, about 0.15 seconds). Suitable for a mascot, a 404 page, or playful interaction. items.desc_en: A trail of balls follows the cursor, merging and stretching like goo between each other

items.desc_en: A video thumbnail is normally still; on hover the play button shrinks and disappears, the picture starts playing, and the progress bar advances
items.prompt_en: Video thumbnail card: normally the picture is slightly dark and still, with a round play button in the middle and the duration shown in the lower right corner; when the mouse hovers, the play button shrinks and fades out, the picture brightens and starts playing (in the demo a slow push-in is used instead), and a progress bar appears at the bottom and starts advancing; when moving away it pauses and returns to the still state. (Implementation: on hover call video.play(), on leave pause() and reset currentTime to zero; the play button transitions with scale and opacity; the video is set to muted and playsinline so it can autoplay)

items.desc: 圖片被切成直條，一條上一條下依序滑走，露出下一張

items.prompt: 圖片輪播的轉場：目前的圖片被切成 6 條等寬的直條，換下一張時，這些直條依序（每條間隔約 0.06 秒）一條往上、一條往下交錯滑出畫面，露出底下的下一張圖，下一張圖同時從 1.15 倍慢慢縮回原尺寸。（實作：每條直條是 overflow:hidden 的容器，裡面放同一張圖並往左位移「條寬 × 索引」使拼起來是完整一張；GSAP 對所有直條 yPercent ±110、stagger 0.06、power3.in）
items.prompt_full:

items.desc_en: An image is cut into vertical strips that slide away in sequence, one up and one down, revealing the next image
items.prompt_en: An image carousel transition: the current image is cut into 6 equal-width vertical strips, and when changing to the next image, these strips in sequence (each spaced about 0.06 seconds apart) slide out of the screen alternating one up and one down, revealing the next image underneath, while the next image simultaneously shrinks slowly back from 1.15 times to the original size. (Implementation: each vertical strip is an overflow: hidden container, with the same image inside shifted left by “strip width × index” so that assembled they form a complete image; GSAP applies yPercent ±110 to all strips, stagger 0.06, power3.in)

(GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub: each heading start "top bottom", end "bottom top", the timeline first fromTo filter blur(12px) → blur(0), opacity 0 → 1, scale .92 → 1, then to blur(12px), opacity 0, scale 1.06)
Colors: please match the website's existing theme colors and style yourself; do not specify any additional colors.

items.desc: 一行文字沿著彎曲的線條移動，捲動決定它跑到哪裡
items.style: 曲線 路徑 文字 跑馬燈 textPath 波浪 捲動 Text On Path Curve Scroll 捲動觸發 ScrollTrigger
items.prompt: 畫面中有一條橫跨的彎曲波浪線（淡淡的細線），一行文字貼著這條曲線排列；使用者往下捲動時，文字沿著曲線從右邊流向左邊，彎曲的地方文字跟著轉彎，捲動速度決定文字移動速度，往回捲則倒退。（SVG：<path id> + <text><textPath href="#id">；GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub tween textPath 的 startOffset 屬性從 100% → −100%）
items.prompt_full:
「沿曲線跑的文字（Text Along Path）」動態效果：畫面中有一條橫跨的彎曲波浪線（淡淡的細線），一行文字貼著這條曲線排列；使用者往下捲動時，文字沿著曲線從右邊流向左邊，彎曲的地方文字跟著轉彎，捲動速度決定文字移動速度，往回捲則倒退。（SVG：<path id> + <text><textPath href="#id">；GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub tween textPath 的 startOffset 屬性從 100% → −100%）
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx:
280(s,x){const{sc,wrap,view}=scrollBox(s);const id='tp'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);view.innerHTML=`<svg class="sx-tp" viewBox="0 0 400 225"><path id="${id}" d="M-20,170 C80,40 160,40 200,112 S320,190 420,60"/><text><textPath href="#${id}" startOffset="100%"></textPath></text></svg>`;
  const tp=view.querySelector('textPath');tp.textContent=rep(x+' · ',3);gsap.fromTo(tp,{attr:{startOffset:'100%'}},{attr:{startOffset:'-100%'},ease:'none',scrollTrigger:{trigger:wrap,scroller:sc,start:'top top',end:'bottom bottom',scrub:.5}});autoScroll(sc)}

items.desc_en: A line of text moves along a curved line, with scrolling deciding how far it runs
items.prompt_en: In the screen there is a curved wavy line spanning across (a faint thin line), and a line of text is arranged hugging this curve; when the user scrolls down, the text flows along the curve from right to left, the text turns with the curve where it bends, scroll speed determines text movement speed, and scrolling back reverses it. (SVG: <path id> + <text><textPath href="#id">; GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub tweens the textPath's startOffset attribute from 100% → −100%)

items.desc: 整個畫面從中間切開成左右兩扇門，隨捲動往兩側拉開，露出下一段
items.style: 對開 開門 拉開 分割 轉場 揭開 Split Doors Curtain Reveal Scroll Transition 捲動觸發 ScrollTrigger
items.prompt: 兩段內容之間的轉場：前一段是一整面強調色的畫面，中間有一個巨大的字；使用者往下捲動時，這個畫面從正中央垂直切開成左右兩扇門（大字也跟著被切成兩半），兩扇門隨捲動進度往左右兩側滑開，露出後面的下一段內容，下一段同時從 0.8 倍放大並變清楚。（GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub：左右兩個各寬 50%、overflow:hidden 的區塊，內部各放一份寬度 200% 的同一個大字（左邊靠左、右邊靠右對齊）讓它看起來是同一個字；timeline 讓兩扇門 xPercent −100 / 100）
items.prompt_full:
「對開門轉場（Split Doors Reveal）」動態效果：兩段內容之間的轉場：前一段是一整面強調色的畫面，中間有一個巨大的字；使用者往下捲動時，這個畫面從正中央垂直切開成左右兩扇門（大字也跟著被切成兩半），兩扇門隨捲動進度往左右兩側滑開，露出後面的下一段內容，下一段同時從 0.8 倍放大並變清楚。（GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub：左右兩個各寬 50%、overflow:hidden 的區塊，內部各放一份寬度 200% 的同一個大字（左邊靠左、右邊靠右對齊）讓它看起來是同一個字；timeline 讓兩扇門 xPercent −100 / 100）
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 281(s,x){const{sc,wrap,view}=scrollBox(s);const nx=el('div','abs gl sx-cn');nx.append(T(x,Math.min(11,50/chars(x).length)));const L=el('div','sx-ct l'),R=el('div','sx-ct r');L.innerHTML=R.innerHTML='SCROLL';view.append(nx,L,R); gsap.timeline({scrollTrigger:{trigger:wrap,scroller:sc,start:'top top',end:'bottom bottom',scrub:.6}}).to(L,{xPercent:-100,ease:'power2.inOut'},.15).to(R,{xPercent:100,ease:'power2.inOut'},.15).fromTo(nx,{scale:.8,opacity:.2},{scale:1,opacity:1,ease:'power2.out'},.15);autoScroll(sc)}

items.desc_en: The whole screen is cut down the middle into left and right doors that pull open to the sides with scrolling, revealing the next section
items.prompt_en: A transition between two sections of content: the previous section is a full screen of an accent color, with a huge character in the middle; when the user scrolls down, this screen is cut vertically from the exact center into left and right doors (the big character is also cut in half along with it), and the two doors slide open to the left and right sides according to scroll progress, revealing the next section behind, while the next section simultaneously enlarges from 0.8 times and becomes clear. (GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub: two blocks each 50% wide with overflow: hidden on the left and right, inside each placing one copy of the same big character at 200% width (the left aligned left, the right aligned right) so it looks like the same character; the timeline moves the two doors to xPercent −100 / 100)

items.desc: 滑過時標題沿水平中線切成上下兩半，往反方向錯開，中間露出一行小字
items.style: 切開 分割 上下 錯開 標題 clip-path Split Text Slice Hover Reveal hover 懸停 滑過
items.prompt: 一個大標題，滑鼠滑過時沿著文字的水平中線被切成上下兩半：上半部往左上錯開、下半部往右下錯開（約 0.5 秒、緩入緩出），兩半之間裂開的縫隙中，一行小字（例如 OPEN）垂直展開淡入；滑開時兩半合回。（CSS：同一段文字疊兩層，一層 clip-path: inset(0 0 50% 0) 只露上半、另一層 inset(50% 0 0 0) 只露下半，:hover 時各自 transform 往反方向位移）
items.prompt_full:
「上下切開文字（Split Text Hover）」動態效果：一個大標題，滑鼠滑過時沿著文字的水平中線被切成上下兩半：上半部往左上錯開、下半部往右下錯開（約 0.5 秒、緩入緩出），兩半之間裂開的縫隙中，一行小字（例如 OPEN）垂直展開淡入；滑開時兩半合回。（CSS：同一段文字疊兩層，一層 clip-path: inset(0 0 50% 0) 只露上半、另一層 inset(50% 0 0 0) 只露下半，:hover 時各自 transform 往反方向位移）
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 282(s,x,card){const w=el('div','ho-sp');w.style.fontSize=Math.min(15,64/chars(x).length)+'cqw';['up','dn','m'].forEach(k=>{const d=el('span','ho-'+k);d.textContent=k==='m'?'':x;w.append(d)});w.querySelector('.ho-m').textContent='OPEN';s.append(w);autoHover(w,[w],card,1500)}

items.desc_en: On hover, a title is cut along its horizontal midline into upper and lower halves that offset in opposite directions, revealing a line of small text in the middle
items.prompt_en: A large title, which when the mouse hovers is cut along the text's horizontal midline into upper and lower halves: the upper half offsets to the upper left, the lower half offsets to the lower right (about 0.5 seconds, easing in and out), and in the gap that cracks open between the two halves, a line of small text (for example OPEN) unfolds vertically and fades in; when moving away the two halves rejoin. (CSS: the same text stacked in two layers, one layer clip-path: inset(0 0 50% 0) showing only the top half, the other inset(50% 0 0 0) showing only the bottom half, on :hover each transforms and displaces in the opposite direction)

(CSS: the same text stacked in two layers, one layer clip-path: inset(0 0 50% 0) showing only the top half, the other inset(50% 0 0 0) showing only the bottom half, on :hover each transforms and displaces in the opposite direction)

items.desc: 滑過時字母間距慢慢拉開、字重變粗，像深呼吸一樣
items.style: 字距 拉開 字重 呼吸 選單 導覽 Letter Spacing Tracking Expand Weight Hover Menu hover 懸停 滑過
items.prompt: 導覽列或大型選單的文字：滑鼠滑過某個項目時，字母間距平滑地從 0 拉開到約 0.35em，字重從細變粗、文字變得更清楚，像深呼吸一樣展開；滑開時收回。約 0.5 秒、減速曲線。（CSS：transition letter-spacing 與 font-weight（使用可變字體效果最平順），:hover 改變數值）
items.prompt_full:
「字距展開（Letter Spacing Expand）」動態效果：導覽列或大型選單的文字：滑鼠滑過某個項目時，字母間距平滑地從 0 拉開到約 0.35em，字重從細變粗、文字變得更清楚，像深呼吸一樣展開；滑開時收回。約 0.5 秒、減速曲線。（CSS：transition letter-spacing 與 font-weight（使用可變字體效果最平順），:hover 改變數值）
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx: 283(s,x,card){const ws=words(x).slice(0,3);const w=el('div','ho-ls');const its=ws.map(t=>{const d=el('div','ho-li');d.textContent=t;w.append(d);return d});s.append(w);autoHover(w,its,card,1100)}

items.desc_en: On hover, letter spacing slowly pulls open and font weight becomes bolder, like taking a deep breath

About 0.5 seconds, with a decelerating curve. (CSS: transition letter-spacing and font-weight (using a variable font gives the smoothest effect), :hover changes the values)

About 0.5 seconds, with a decelerating curve. (CSS: transition letter-spacing and font-weight (using a variable font gives the smoothest effect), :hover changes the values)

items.desc: 滑過清單某一列時，底色從左邊刷進來，文字往右讓位、箭頭滑出
items.style: 清單 列表 服務項目 選單 底色 填滿 箭頭 List Row Hover Fill Sweep Arrow Services Menu hover 懸停 滑過
items.txt: 品牌識別 網站設計 動態影像 包裝設計
items.prompt: 一份服務項目清單，每列有編號、項目名稱、右側箭頭，列與列之間有細分隔線：滑鼠滑過某一列時，一塊實心底色從左邊刷進來填滿整列，項目名稱往右移一點讓位，右側箭頭從左邊滑入出現，文字顏色反轉以保持可讀；滑開時底色往右收走。約 0.5 秒。（CSS：每列內一個絕對定位的底色層 transform:scaleX(0)，hover 時 scaleX(1) 且 transform-origin 從 left；離開時 transform-origin 改成 right，形成「左進右出」）
items.prompt_full:

example.javascript_fx: 284(s,x,card){const ws=words(x).slice(0,4);const w=el('ul','ho-rw');const its=ws.map((t,i)=>{const li=el('li');li.innerHTML='0'+(i+1)+'';li.querySelector('b').textContent=t;w.append(li);return li});s.append(w);autoHover(w,its,card,1000)}

items.desc_en: When hovering over a list row, the background color brushes in from the left, the text makes way to the right, and an arrow slides out
items.prompt_en: A list of service items, each row with a number, an item name, and an arrow on the right, with thin divider lines between rows: when the mouse hovers over a row, a solid background color brushes in from the left to fill the whole row, the item name moves a little to the right to make way, the arrow on the right slides in from the left and appears, and the text color inverts to stay readable; when moving away the background color retracts to the right. About 0.5 seconds. (CSS: inside each row an absolutely positioned background layer transform: scaleX(0), on hover scaleX(1) with transform-origin from left; on leave transform-origin changes to right, forming “in from the left, out to the right”)

About 0.5 seconds. (CSS: inside each row an absolutely positioned background layer transform: scaleX(0), on hover scaleX(1) with transform-origin from left; on leave transform-origin changes to right, forming “in from the left, out to the right”)

items.desc: 滑過圖示時各自做出符合意思的小動作：鈴鐺搖、愛心跳、齒輪轉、垃圾桶掀蓋
items.style: 圖示 icon 微動畫 鈴鐺 愛心 齒輪 垃圾桶 Icon Micro Animation Bell Heart Gear Trash Hover hover 懸停 滑過
items.prompt: 一排功能圖示按鈕（通知、收藏、設定、刪除），滑鼠滑過時圖示的底色亮起，並各自做出符合意思的微動畫：鈴鐺以頂端為軸左右搖晃幾下後停住；愛心填滿並跳動一下；齒輪的齒轉 90 度並帶一點回彈；垃圾桶的蓋子以左端為軸掀開一個角度。讓介面更有生命力又不干擾。（CSS：SVG 圖示的特定部位設 transform-origin（SVG 內元素記得 transform-box:fill-box），:hover 時套用各自的 keyframes 或 transform transition）

items.desc_en: On hovering over icons, each performs a small action matching its meaning: a bell shakes, a heart jumps, a gear turns, a trash can lifts its lid
items.prompt_en: A row of function icon buttons (notifications, favorites, settings, delete); when the mouse hovers, the icon's background lights up, and each performs a micro-animation matching its meaning: the bell shakes left and right a few times pivoting on its top, then stops; the heart fills and jumps once; the gear's teeth rotate 90 degrees with a little bounce; the trash can's lid lifts open at an angle pivoting on its left end. items.style: 卡片 資訊 面板 滑上 說明 作品 Card Info Slide Up Overlay Details Hover hover 懸停 滑過
items.txt: 海邊 山林 夜空

items.desc_en: The strokes of the text are drawn one stroke at a time as if written with a pen, then fill in once finished
items.prompt_en: A piece of text (for example a signature or "Thank you") presented in a handwritten-style font: at first you see only blank space, then the outline strokes of the text are drawn along the letterforms one stroke at a time (about 2.4 seconds), as if someone is writing with a pen; after the strokes are drawn, the inside of the letters fades in to fill them. (SVG: set stroke and fill on the <text>; use a stroke-dasharray equal to or greater than the total path length, and tween stroke-dashoffset from the total length to 0; after drawing, fill-opacity 0 → 1. For greater precision, convert the text to a path and use DrawSVG)

items.prompt_full:

items.desc: 游標像一盞燈，文字的長陰影永遠朝游標的反方向延伸
items.style: 光源 投影 陰影 長陰影 立體 游標 Light Source Long Shadow Cursor 3D Text 文字 標題 動態文字
items.prompt: 區塊中有一個大標題，游標位置是一顆發光的小光源：文字背後有一道由多層陰影組成的長陰影，陰影永遠朝「遠離游標」的方向延伸，越遠的層顏色越淡；游標移動時陰影方向即時跟著轉動，像光源在繞著文字移動。（JS：mousemove 計算游標相對於文字中心的方向向量，產生 18 層 text-shadow，每層偏移 = 方向 × 層數，顏色依層數逐漸變淡）
items.prompt_full:
「光源投影字（Light Source Shadow）」動態效果：區塊中有一個大標題，游標位置是一顆發光的小光源：文字背後有一道由多層陰影組成的長陰影，陰影永遠朝「遠離游標」的方向延伸，越遠的層顏色越淡；游標移動時陰影方向即時跟著轉動，像光源在繞著文字移動。（JS：mousemove 計算游標相對於文字中心的方向向量，產生 18 層 text-shadow，每層偏移 = 方向 × 層數，顏色依層數逐漸變淡）
配色：請依照網站既有的主題色與風格自行搭配，不要另外指定顏色。

example.javascript_fx:
294(s,x,card){const l=el('div','abs gl tx-ls');const t=T(x,Math.min(15,64/chars(x).length));const sun=el('i','tx-sun');l.append(t,sun);s.append(l);
  vpointer(l,card,(px,py)=>{const W=l.offsetWidth,H=l.offsetHeight,dx=(W/2-px)/W,dy=(H/2-py)/H,n=18,sh=[];for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)sh.push(`${(dx*i*1.4).toFixed(1)}px ${(dy*i*1.4).toFixed(1)}px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--a) ${Math.round(100-i/n*85)}%,#15161a)`);t.style.textShadow=sh.join(',');sun.style.transform=`translate(${px}px,${py}px)`})}

items.desc_en: The cursor is like a lamp, and the text's long shadow always extends in the direction opposite the cursor
items.prompt_en: There is a large heading in a section, and the cursor position is a small glowing light source: behind the text is a long shadow made of multiple shadow layers, and the shadow always extends in the direction "away from the cursor", with layers farther away becoming fainter in color; as the cursor moves, the shadow's direction turns in real time to follow, as if the light source is moving around the text. (JS: on mousemove, compute the direction vector of the cursor relative to the text's center, and generate 18 layers of text-shadow, each layer's offset = direction × layer number, with the color gradually fading by layer number)

items.desc: 每個字從模糊、略大的狀態依序變清楚並落定
items.style: 模糊 浮現 逐字 柔和 進場 Blur In Letters Soft Reveal Stagger 文字 標題 動態文字

「逐字模糊浮現（Blur In Letters）」動態效果：標題的每個字依序從「模糊、透明、略大、略低」的狀態變成清楚並落到定位，每個字間隔約 0.07 秒，整體柔和、有質感；停留一段時間後依序模糊淡出再重播。（GSAP + SplitText：fromTo 字元 {opacity:0, filter:"blur(10px)", y:".25em", scale:1.15} → {opacity:1, filter:"blur(0px)", y:0, scale:1}，ease power2.out、stagger 0.07）

example.javascript_fx: 296(s,x){const t=T(x);s.append(t);const sp=SplitText.create(t,{type:'chars'});gsap.timeline({repeat:-1,repeatDelay:.4}).fromTo(sp.chars,{opacity:0,filter:'blur(10px)',y:'.25em',scale:1.15},{opacity:1,filter:'blur(0px)',y:0,scale:1,duration:.9,ease:'power2.out',stagger:.07}).to(sp.chars,{opacity:0,filter:'blur(10px)',duration:.6,stagger:.03,ease:'power1.in'},'+=1.6')}

items.desc: 文字後面疊著好幾層空心的複製，依序往斜後方展開再收回

example.javascript_fx: 299(s,x){const w=el('div','tx-ec');w.style.fontSize=Math.min(14,60/chars(x).length)+'cqw';for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const d=el('span');d.textContent=x;d.style.setProperty('--i',i);w.append(d)}s.append(w)}

items.desc: 不同語言的「你好」輪流出現，模糊淡入淡出，外框寬度平滑跟著變
items.style: 多語 問候 你好 Hello 切換 國際 Multilingual Greeting Hello Languages Rotate 文字 標題 動態文字

"ECG Heartbeat Line (心電圖線條)" motion effect: An ECG display for a medical or health app: on a dark screen with fine grid lines, a glowing ECG waveform (flat line, small wave, the sharp QRS wave, T wave, repeating) is drawn from left to right, and a glowing cursor dot advances along with the drawing front; after drawing to the end, the line begins disappearing from the left side and is redrawn; the top-right shows a heart-rate figure (occasionally varying slightly) and a heart beating regularly. (GSAP: DrawSVG "0% 0%" → "0% 100%" to draw it out, then to "100% 100%" to make it disappear; the cursor dot uses MotionPathPlugin along the same path; the heart uses scale yoyo)
Colors: please match the website's existing theme colors and style yourself; do not specify any additional colors.

items.desc: 樹幹先長出來，再分出枝條，最後葉子一片片冒出
items.style: 樹 生長 植物 枝條 葉子 成長 永續 Growing Tree Plant Branches Leaves Growth 圖形 SVG
items.prompt: 一棵樹由下往上生長：先畫出地面線與主幹（約 0.8 秒），接著左右分枝依序長出，再長出更細的小枝；枝條畫完後，葉子以隨機順序一片片從枝條末端彈出（從 0 放大到 1，帶回彈）；最後下方文字浮現。適合品牌故事、成長或永續主題。（GSAP timeline：每條枝條是 SVG path，用 DrawSVG 0% → 100% 依序畫出；葉子 scale 0 → 1、transform-origin 在葉柄、stagger from:"random"）

items.desc_en: The trunk grows first, then branches split off, and finally the leaves emerge one by one
items.prompt_en: A tree grows from the bottom up: first the ground line and the main trunk are drawn (about 0.8 seconds), then branches to the left and right grow out in sequence, followed by finer twigs; after the branches are drawn, leaves pop out one by one from the ends of the branches in random order (enlarging from 0 to 1, with a bounce-back); finally text emerges below. Suitable for brand stories, growth or sustainability themes. (GSAP timeline: each branch is an SVG path, drawn in sequence with DrawSVG 0% → 100%; the leaves use scale 0 → 1, transform-origin at the leaf stem, stagger from:"random")

items.desc: 三個大小不同的齒輪咬合在一起，依齒數比例以不同速度互相帶動
items.style: 齒輪 連動 機械 運轉 設定 系統 Gears Cogs Mechanism Rotation Settings 圖形 SVG
items.prompt: 三個大小與齒數不同的齒輪彼此咬合：最大的齒輪以固定速度順時針轉動，與它咬合的兩個較小齒輪依照齒數比例以較快的速度逆時針轉動（齒數少的轉得快），齒與齒對準不會穿模，像機械系統正在運作；適合「處理中」、設定或系統狀態的畫面。（SVG：用程式依半徑與齒數產生齒輪輪廓 path；GSAP 讓每個齒輪 rotation 無限循環，小齒輪的角速度 = 大齒輪 × (大齒數 ÷ 小齒數)、方向相反，並設定初始相位讓齒對齊）

「齒輪連動（Gear Train）」動態效果：三個大小與齒數不同的齒輪彼此咬合：最大的齒輪以固定速度順時針轉動，與它咬合的兩個較小齒輪依照齒數比例以較快的速度逆時針轉動（齒數少的轉得快），齒與齒對準不會穿模，像機械系統正在運作；適合「處理中」、設定或系統狀態的畫面。（SVG：用程式依半徑與齒數產生齒輪輪廓 path；GSAP 讓每個齒輪 rotation 無限循環，小齒輪的角速度 = 大齒輪 × (大齒數 ÷ 小齒數)、方向相反，並設定初始相位讓齒對齊）

items.desc_en: Three gears of different sizes mesh together, driving each other at different speeds according to their tooth-count ratio
items.prompt_en: Three gears of different sizes and tooth counts mesh with each other: the largest gear rotates clockwise at a fixed speed, and the two smaller gears meshing with it rotate counterclockwise at higher speeds according to their tooth-count ratio (the one with fewer teeth turns faster), with tooth aligned to tooth and no clipping, like a mechanical system in operation; suitable for "processing", settings or system-status screens. (SVG: generate each gear's outline path programmatically from its radius and tooth count; GSAP loops each gear's rotation infinitely, with a small gear's angular velocity = the large gear × (large tooth count ÷ small tooth count), in the opposite direction, and sets the initial phase so the teeth align)
items.style_en: Gears Linked Mechanism Running Settings System Gears Cogs Mechanism Rotation Settings Graphics SVG
items.prompt_full_en:
"Gear Train (齒輪連動)" motion effect: Three gears of different sizes and tooth counts mesh with each other: the largest gear rotates clockwise at a fixed speed, and the two smaller gears meshing with it rotate counterclockwise at higher speeds according to their tooth-count ratio (the one with fewer teeth turns faster), with tooth aligned to tooth and no clipping, like a mechanical system in operation; suitable for "processing", settings or system-status screens. (SVG: generate each gear's outline path programmatically from its radius and tooth count; GSAP loops each gear's rotation infinitely, with a small gear's angular velocity = the large gear × (large tooth count ÷ small tooth count), in the opposite direction, and sets the initial phase so the teeth align)

items.desc: 指紋紋路一圈圈畫出，掃描光條上下掃過，成功後外框發光並打勾
items.style: 指紋 掃描 解鎖 生物辨識 驗證 登入 Fingerprint Scan Biometric Unlock Auth 圖形 SVG
items.prompt: 手機指紋解鎖畫面：圓角方形感應區中，指紋的弧線紋路由內而外一圈圈依序畫出；接著一條發光的掃描光條由上往下、再由下往上掃過，下方文字顯示「掃描中…」；掃描完成後指紋紋路變淡，一個粗勾勾快速畫出，感應區外框發出光暈，文字變成「驗證成功」。（GSAP timeline：指紋弧線用 DrawSVG stagger 畫出；掃描條 top 0% → 100% yoyo；完成時加 class 讓外框 box-shadow 發光，勾勾 DrawSVG 0% → 100%）

items.desc_en: Fingerprint ridges are drawn ring by ring, a scanning light bar sweeps up and down, and after success the frame glows and a checkmark appears
items.prompt_en: A phone fingerprint-unlock screen: in a rounded-square sensing area, the fingerprint's curved ridges are drawn in sequence ring by ring from the inside out; then a glowing scanning light bar sweeps from top to bottom and back from bottom to top, and the text below shows "Scanning…"; after the scan completes, the fingerprint ridges fade, a thick checkmark is quickly drawn, the sensing area's frame emits a glow, and the text changes to "Verified". (GSAP timeline: the fingerprint arcs are drawn with DrawSVG stagger; the scanning bar top 0% → 100% yoyo; on completion, add a class to make the frame's box-shadow glow, and the checkmark DrawSVG 0% → 100%)
